name: codex-codebuddy-workbench
description: Open the current project in a CodeBuddy-style workbench: file tree with git badges, tabbed file preview, hideable web terminal on a real PTY, and a chat panel bridged to codex exec.

interface.longDescription: Launch a local browser workbench that mirrors the CodeBuddy IDE layout: left file tree with git status badges, tabbed preview for code / Markdown / images / PDF, a hideable bottom terminal backed by a real PTY with shell switching, and a right-hand chat panel wired to codex exec so the agent keeps working in the same project. Column widths and visibility persist.
defaultPrompt: 用 CodeBuddy 布局打开当前项目
